id: \rHi there. You must be \PN. Let's make this quick. I have Bug Pokémon to get back to.
en: \rHi there. You must be \PN. Let's make this quick. I have Bug Pokémon to get back to.
it: \rCiao. Tu devi essere \PN. Facciamo in fretta. Ho dei Pokémon Coleottero che mi aspettano.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 890.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 890.
it: Smart Rotom: In base ai risultati, la tua posizione in classifica ora è 890.

id: \rI collect Bug-types. I've already gotten all of the ones from Sinnoh.
en: \rI collect Bug-types. I've already gotten all of the ones from Sinnoh.
it: \rColleziono Pokémon di tipo Coleottero. Ho già preso tutti quelli di Sinnoh.

id: \rI'm sorry to bother you, but I'm taking care of an Egg that refuses to hatch. However, it reacted to your presence.
en: \rI'm sorry to bother you, but I'm taking care of an Egg that refuses to hatch. However, it reacted to your presence.
it: \rMi dispiace disturbarti, ma mi sto prendendo cura di un Uovo che non vuole proprio schiudersi. Però ha reagito alla tua presenza.

id: \rWould you like to take care of it? I feel it could hatch if it was with you.
en: \rWould you like to take care of it? I feel it could hatch if it was with you.
it: \rTi andrebbe di prendertene cura tu? Ho la sensazione che potrebbe schiudersi se stesse con te.

id: \rOh, you can't carry it with you.
en: \rOh, you can't carry it with you.

id: \rMake some space in your party and then talk to me outside.
en: \rMake some space in your party and then talk to me outside.
it: \rFai un po' di spazio nella tua squadra e poi parlami fuori.

id: \rOh. Will this little one ever hatch?
en: \rOh. Will this little one ever hatch?
it: \rOh. Chissà se questo piccolino si schiuderà mai...

id: \bWant to trade it for my Farfetch'd?
en: \bWant to trade it for my Farfetch'd?

id: \bMy Pokémon was poisoned!\nIt almost fainted while we were walking!
en: \bMy Pokémon was poisoned!\nIt almost fainted while we were walking!
it: \bIl mio Pokémon è stato avvelenato!\nStava quasi per andare KO mentre camminavamo!

id: \rWant to trade it for my Zorua?
en: \rWant to trade it for my Zorua?

it: \rNon vuoi fare lo scambio?  Va bene.

id: \bEven if they are the same level, Pokémon can have very different stats and abilities.
en: \bEven if they are the same level, Pokémon can have very different stats and abilities.
it: \bAnche se hanno lo stesso livello, i Pokémon possono avere statistiche e abilità molto diverse.

id: \bA Pokémon raised by a Trainer is stronger than one in the wild.
en: \bA Pokémon raised by a Trainer is stronger than one in the wild.
it: \bUn Pokémon allenato da un Allenatore è più forte di uno selvatico.

id: \rWant to trade it for my Cufant?
en: \rWant to trade it for my Cufant?

id: \bWant to trade it for my Stunfisk?
en: \bWant to trade it for my Stunfisk?

id: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
en: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.

id: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
it: \rQui rimettiamo in forze i tuoi Pokémon stanchi.

id: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?

id: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
en: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
it: \rBene, prendo i tuoi Pokémon per qualche secondo.

id: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
en: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon potrebbero aver contratto il Pokérus.

id: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
en: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
it: \rSi sa poco del Pokérus, se non che si tratta di forme di vita microscopiche che si attaccano ai Pokémon.

id: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
en: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
it: \rSi dice che i Pokémon infetti crescano eccezionalmente bene.

id: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono di nuovo in piena forma.

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
en: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati e sono in perfetta salute.
